title: Unbalanced correlation-immune Boolean function
statement: For every natural number $n$ divisible by $3$, there is a function from the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{−1,1\\}$ whose uniform mean is nonzero and whose nonempty Fourier coefficients of degrees at most $2n/3-1$ all vanish.
